points.name: Uldaman (outside portal)
points.note: Back (north-west) entrance in the Badlands; position not sourced

points.name: Revelosh
points.note: First boss, east/south-centre. Drops the Shaft of Tsol (needed for the Staff of Prehistoria).

points.name: The Lost Dwarves
points.note: Baelog, Eric and Olaf in the far south room; kill them together in the room.

points.name: Ironaya
points.note: Behind the door that needs the Staff of Prehistoria (Shaft of Tsol + Gni'kiv Medallion).

points.name: Obsidian Sentinel
points.note: Boss-like elite in the west part of the hall.

points.name: Ancient Stone Keeper
points.note: Centre of the floor; stone golem with a stun/knock.

points.name: Galgann Firehammer
points.note: North-west dwarf boss with ranged Dark Iron help; kill him BEFORE looting the objects nearby.

points.name: Grimlok
points.note: Stonevault leader in the far north-west.

points.name: Archaedas
points.note: Final boss on the second floor; he wakes stone guardians as the fight goes on.

points.name: The Discs of Norgannon
points.note: After Archaedas: right-click the Discs to start the quest (object ID 131474 per AllTheThings). Position estimated next to the boss.

points.name: Archaedas treasure chest (Hall of the Crafters)
points.note: Appears after Archaedas dies; 2-3 items (object ID 141979 per AllTheThings). Position estimated next to the boss.

points.name: Gni'kiv Medallion source (object)
points.note: Object 123329 gives the Gni'kiv Medallion; combine with the Shaft of Tsol to make the Staff of Prehistoria for Ironaya (AllTheThings description). Position not sourced.

strategies.text: Lightning-based caster boss; keep the group close so heals stay efficient and move out of his chain effects.
Three brothers: focus one at a time and keep the tank on the main one while the others are tanked or CC'd.
Stuns/knocks nearby players with a stomp; melee should not stack and the healer should stay out of range.
His Dark Iron adds bring fire damage; kill the casters first, and do not loot nearby objects until he is dead.
Clear the area so no stone guards are awake first. He wakes minions in waves; focus the guards when they stun.
